I am solving this pyq as the new syllabus to same as Intro to Linux course in ES. Ctrl + z converts a foreground process to background. But in the command sleep 200 & & already makes this a background process right? So, how is the Ctrl + Z option correct? @22F3002354

posts.name: Yash Rastogi
posts.cooked: Your logic is sound, only the last option is correct here.

posts.name: pankaj joshi
posts.cooked:
I think here the “&” is the possible issue, this shouldn’t be there because “kill -20 344” ( SIGTSTP) is same as pressing ctrl+z on computer.
Thus both options are correct and the error is there in the question.
Hope it helps !!!

posts.name: Yash Rastogi
posts.cooked: Without the & only Ctrl + Z would be the valid option as sleep command would occupy the terminal while executing.

posts.name: pankaj joshi
posts.cooked:
Thank you for the clarification ., but,
the command already runs the process in the background due to & and there’s no need to use kill -20 344, though the process is already detached from the terminal.
